title: Case VI (Serial 4822.00): Illustration of Domed Disc with White Top and Red Rim
description: Shaded side-view illustration of a domed, disc-shaped object. Callouts mark the upper surface "White", the lower rim "Deep red" and one edge "No light". The text describes an instrument technician's 15-minute observation on December 22, 1952 of an object that climbed in spurts, rolled to show a red side and darted back and forth south of Jupiter (page 82).
